description: The shared conformance cases of the formula language (ADR-0042). The server checks every case and writes each accepted formula's checked tree into ast (-Dformula.update=true); the web interprets ast with the same values and scope and must give the same result or failure. A case with error is a check the server refuses.

cases.note: an empty value: a rule passes, a condition does not apply
the request zone is ahead of UTC
